unit: DISTINCT case (niche, source_pain, subject_name, peer_name). All 38 distinct cases in the eligible population were labelled — no sampling, so there is no sampling error in precision/allow-case. Labels were written AFTER arms A-E were measured but WITHOUT consulting per-arm outcomes case by case; the criterion below was fixed first.
criterion: should_flip iff the PEER's cited evidence (incumbent name + capability, which is the ONLY evidence arm B supplies) establishes that a commercial product, first-party feature, or free/DIY route delivers a shipped / partial-adjacent / substitute version of the SUBJECT's own core mechanism. should_stay_none iff the cited capability bears on the PEER's mechanism or some other mechanism but not the SUBJECT's, or the stamp is corrupt/uninformative. Production's own low bar for 'partial (adjacent/limited commercial version)' was used, resolving genuine borderlines toward should_flip so the mechanism gets the benefit of the doubt.
